claims.what: setting: histories of mistakes whose effects stay in the world
claims.quote: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: prior work: cleaning at a fixed world
claims.quote: Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: method: freeze mid-task, edit history or world, receiver continues
claims.quote: We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: AgentCE-Bench edits: truthful note vs completed action
claims.quote: On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: truthful note vs matched neutral note (recovery)
claims.quote: The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: AppWorld: receipt success/failure x effect present/absent
claims.quote: On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.what: success receipt vs effect presence (whole-task success)
claims.quote: A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable

claims.quote: A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.
claims.on_unmeasured: not measured, re-run or re-claimed here; the sketch's fixture counts are not comparable
